hero.title: Custom Software. Reliable Infrastructure. One Expert Team.
hero.description: We build custom software, manage the infrastructure behind it, and keep everything running. One team, direct communication, no handoffs.

offers.title: What we offer.
offers.bothDescription: — one team writes it, ships it and keeps it running. No handoffs.

stack.title: The stack we actually work in.

team.title: The people you'll actually work with.

call.title: Call
call.description: 30 minutes with the founder about what you need.
call.subtitle: 30 minutes

scope.title: Scope / Audit
scope.description: We map what to build — or what's at risk. Fixed price, agreed upfront.
scope.subtitle: 1–4 weeks

build.title: Build / Fix
build.description: Working results every two weeks, not a reveal at the end.
build.subtitle: Depends on scope

support.title: Support
support.description: We stay on monthly — or hand everything over, documented.
support.subtitle: Ongoing

cost.title: How much does it cost?
cost.description: Projects and audits are fixed price, agreed before we start. Ongoing work is billed monthly. No surprises on the invoice.

developer.title: We already have a developer doing this.
developer.description: That's usually how it starts — until they're stuck between shipping features and fixing fires. We take infrastructure off their plate and leave it documented, so they're never the only one who knows how it works.

availability.title: You're a small team. What if someone's out?
availability.description: Everything we build is automated and documented — nothing lives in one person's head. And we're upfront about limits: we don't sell 24/7 on-call.
